auxiliary_nonflop_ops.policy: Only comparisons, indexing, shape/view, data movement, integer/bit operations and other explicitly documented non-floating-point operations are listed here; unknown computational operators still abort the run.

working_memory_diagnostic.note: Transient working memory; excluded from persistent storage.

method_parameters.source: CVPR 2025 TagFex image-network structure, losses, expansion, herding and alignment ported to Avalanche

protocol.technical_input_conversion: raw binary [T,C] -> [C,T] persistence view -> runtime RGB 160x160 at model boundary
protocol.spike_replay_persistence: selected samples are stored as true 1-bit packed arrays; uint8/float32 tensors exist only while replay is materialized
protocol.spike_replay_label_persistence: uint8 one-hot using one byte per class entry
protocol.flop_convention: 1 MAC = 2 FLOPs; no post-hoc doubling of PyTorch 2.11 totals
protocol.tagfex_two_view_policy: two value-identical views because protocol augmentation is none; replay is merged before the student forward and the inseparable mixed optimization step remains in core_training

summary_null_reasons.cil_performance.intransigence: Disabled for search/joint learning or explicitly skipped for this formal run.
